description: Permissions for the OIS main window: Tauri's core defaults, signed auto-update (#347), native notifications (#348), and creating and placing the always-on-top pop-outs (#349). A notification click raises the window from Rust (src/notify.rs), so the window controls here are for raising an already-open pop-out, not for notification clicks. Pop-out windows get their own, smaller set — see popout.json.
